description: This file is a PHPUnit test case for the WorkShiftService class within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for methods such as saving, retrieving all, and retrieving a WorkShift by ID. The class extends a custom TestCase and uses mocks to test the service layer independently.

classes.name: WorkShiftServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the WorkShiftService functionalities including saving shifts, fetching lists, and retrieving by ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a new instance of WorkShiftService and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests the saveWorkShift method of the DAO to ensure it correctly saves and returns a WorkShift object.

methods.name: testGetAllWorkShifts
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all WorkShift objects using the service layer.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific WorkShift by ID.
